settings.tagline: Rustic Mountain Eco-Stay in Dawaipani, Darjeeling
settings.subtagline: Simple, clean, and comfortable accommodation nestled amidst natural mineral springs, tea garden landscapes, and views of Mount Kanchenjunga.
settings.section1Text: Mineral Springs Retreat is a peaceful eco-stay offering an authentic mountain experience in Dawaipani. We provide simple, clean, and comfortable accommodation with attached Western-style toilets, geysers for hot water, basic essential amenities, and private balconies where you can watch the magical afternoon mist drift gently into your room.
settings.section2Text: Enjoy traditional, heartwarming home-style Gorkha and Nepali meals freshly prepared with locally harvested ingredients. Every reservation includes our full 4-meal plan: hearty breakfast, wholesome lunch, evening snacks & Himalayan tea, and warming dinner.
settings.section3Text: Perched on the tranquil slopes of Dawaipani, our retreat commands sweeping vistas of Mount Kanchenjunga on clear days. By evening, witness the breathtaking sparkling lights of Darjeeling town and Namchi illuminating the valley below.

tariffDetails.note: Rates are indicative and may vary depending on season, availability and group size. Please contact us to confirm the latest tariff.

roadConditions.title: Road Conditions
roadConditions.summary: The final approach road to Dawaipani village is steep, narrow, and rough in places.
roadConditions.advice: A suitable rugged vehicle, such as a Bolero or Sumo, is strongly recommended. Guests should coordinate with the property before travelling to confirm current road conditions and suitable transport.

foodConveniences.title: Food & Local Conveniences
foodConveniences.summary: Traditional Gorkha/Nepali home-cooked meals prepared with local ingredients.
foodConveniences.advice: The food experience is authentic and home-style. Please note that there are no major commercial markets or luxury restaurants within easy walking distance. Guests should plan and purchase their essential personal items before reaching the property.

howToReach.details: Journey time depends on mountain road and weather conditions. Bolero / Sumo transfer can be coordinated.
Direct scenic mountain drive via Rohini or Pankhabari routes. Coordinate with us for trusted local transport.
Guests can first reach Darjeeling town and then hire a local 4WD / rugged vehicle for the journey to the retreat.

perks.title: Medicinal Water Springs
perks.description: The name Dawaipani translates to 'medicated water' in local heritage. The village is associated with local streams and natural mineral water springs that have historically been believed by local communities to have rejuvenating properties.

perks.title: Trekking & Hidden Waterfalls
perks.description: Explore winding village trails, discover pristine natural waterfalls, and trek along nearby riverbanks such as the Rung Dung River. Walks and treks should be undertaken with local guidance where necessary.

perks.title: Panoramic Kanchenjunga
perks.description: On clear days, visitors can enjoy spectacular panoramic views of Mount Kanchenjunga. At night, marvel at the glittering lights of Darjeeling town and Namchi across the valley.

perks.title: Tea Garden & Village Walks
perks.description: The retreat is surrounded by the broader Lebong and Mineral Spring Tea Garden landscape. Enjoy morning walks through tea gardens, bird-watching, and peaceful village paths.

perks.title: Bonfire & Mountain Barbecue
perks.description: Gather beneath the crisp mountain night sky. Bonfire and barbecue arrangements are available on request, subject to weather conditions and availability.

experiences.title: Mineral Springs Waterfall & River Trek
experiences.tagline: Cascading natural waters, riverbed boulders & untouched wilderness
experiences.description: Hike through cardamom groves and virgin subtropical forests down to the authentic Mineral Springs mountain waterfalls. Wade in crystal pools, sit on moss-covered boulders, and immerse in pristine Himalayan sounds.

experiences.title: Organic Tea Garden Walk & First Flush Tasting
experiences.tagline: Hand-plucked tender leaves, dewdrop mornings & estate heritage
experiences.description: Stroll through the manicured contour slopes of nearby organic Darjeeling tea gardens. Witness traditional two-leaves-and-a-bud plucking and savor fresh-brewed aromatic Darjeeling tea back at the retreat.

experiences.title: Kanchenjunga Sunrise & Cloud Inversion Watch
experiences.tagline: 180-degree Sleeping Buddha panorama above a silent sea of clouds
experiences.description: Awaken with fresh mountain ginger tea on your private wooden verandah. Watch the first golden rays illuminate the snow peaks of Mt. Kanchenjunga while white cloud inversions flood the valley below.
highlights: Warm morning brew on wooden balcony

experiences.title: Cardamom Forest & Village Ridge Trails
experiences.tagline: Stone trails, fluttering prayer flags & peaceful hamlet life
experiences.description: Follow scenic stone pathways winding past hillside cottages, fluttering Buddhist prayer flags, and terraced organic farms. Breathe in pure mountain air and experience genuine Gorkha mountain culture.

experiences.title: UNESCO Darjeeling Toy Train Heritage Excursion
experiences.tagline: Historic steam locomotive winding through misty pine forests
experiences.description: Take a scenic excursion to the Darjeeling Himalayan Railway (DHR). Watch authentic blue steam engines puff smoke along narrow-gauge tracks carved into steep mountain slopes—a UNESCO World Heritage landmark.

intro.heading: Mineral Springs Retreat in the heart of the mountains is an authentic sanctuary offering simple, clean accommodations with unrivaled tea garden walks and valley peace.

about.heroSubtitle: A peaceful retreat born from mountain heritage and natural mineral springs.
about.storyParagraph1: Mineral Springs Retreat was established as an authentic sanctuary in the tranquil hamlet of Dawaipani, approximately 15 km from Darjeeling town. Surrounded by dense pine forests and the emerald slopes of the Lebong tea gardens, our retreat offers travelers a peaceful refuge from urban haste.
about.storyParagraph2: Our architecture honors traditional Himalayan timber craftsmanship, with rustic wooden verandas, locally sourced pine finishes, and private balconies that frame uninterrupted vistas of Mount Kanchenjunga. Here, the afternoons bring gentle clouds flowing through your room, and evenings bring glowing village lights and starlit skies.

dawaipani.title: Discover Dawaipani
dawaipani.subtitle: A secluded hill village perched at 6,500 ft, renowned for panoramic Kanchenjunga views, pure mountain air, and tranquil tea estates.
dawaipani.weatherHighlights: Cool summers (15°C – 22°C), crisp misty monsoons, and clear cold winters (2°C – 12°C) with spectacular snow-capped views.

sections.heading: The Name & History
sections.text: Dawaipani translates literally to 'Medicinal Water' in Nepali, named after the natural therapeutic mineral springs that flow through the surrounding forests. Travelers historically came to these hills seeking the rejuvenating qualities of its pure spring waters and undisturbed pine canopy.

sections.heading: Kanchenjunga Panoramic Vista
sections.text: Unlike crowded hill stations, Dawaipani offers an unobstructed, 180-degree panorama of Mount Kanchenjunga and its sibling peaks. On crisp mornings, witness the world's third highest peak turn from deep violet to glistening Himalayan gold.

sections.heading: Lebong Mineral Spring Tea Estate
sections.text: The retreat borders the historic Lebong and Mineral Spring Tea Gardens. Guests can take guided nature walks through terraced organic tea slopes, observe artisan leaf plucking, and breathe in the distinctive floral fragrance of Darjeeling tea in flush.

stay.title: Rooms & Accommodations
stay.subtitle: Simple, clean, and comfortable rustic rooms with private balconies and inclusive 4-meal plans.
stay.mealPlanNotice: Every reservation includes all 4 daily home-cooked meals: Morning Breakfast, Wholesome Lunch, Evening Tea & Snacks, and Warming Dinner.
rules: Check-in at 12:00 PM; Check-out at 11:00 AM.
Rates are per person per night and include all 4 daily meals.
Attached Western toilets with 24/7 hot geyser water in all rooms.
Advance booking is recommended during peak Kanchenjunga viewing seasons.

experiences.title: Curated Mountain Experiences
experiences.subtitle: From mist-bathed morning balconies to starlit deck bonfires and tea garden walks.
experiences.introText: Every moment at Mineral Springs Retreat is crafted around the quiet wonder of the Himalayas. Immerse yourself in authentic village walks, music on the timber verandah, and heartfelt conversations with your local hosts.

travel.title: Travel & Route Guide
travel.subtitle: How to reach Mineral Springs Retreat in Dawaipani from major transit hubs.
travel.altitudeWarning: Dawaipani is located at 6,500 ft elevation. The final 3 km approach follows a scenic mountain road. 4WD / high-clearance vehicles are recommended during monsoon months.

Via Teesta Bazaar and Peshok Road

travel.taxiAssistanceText: We can arrange reliable local pick-up and drop-off taxis from NJP Railway Station, Siliguri, and Bagdogra Airport upon request.

reservation.cancellationPolicy: Full refund for cancellations made 7 or more days prior to check-in. 50% refund for cancellations within 3-6 days. No refund for cancellations within 48 hours.
